scientific_integrity: Proof includes non-asymptotic variational bounds and critical asymptotics; finite checker only supplies supporting numerical evidence; prior construction and the earlier diagonal C3 counterexamples are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Closed Euclidean disk forcing and strictly positive diagonal contractions; contact classified only at the two vertical extrema. No all-parameter C3 classification, no exact power-prefactor, no independent audit; prior 2022 thesis contains separate related regularity obstructions.
title: A three-phase axial flatness law for disk-forced diagonal contractions
